overview: یک جوان سگ می‌گیرد که متوجه می‌شود این سگ مورد تعقیب مجرمان است.
overview_en: When a cute Welsh terrier follows Bill Denny home, little does he know that all gangland has its eye on that dog. Who will be bumbling Bill's undoing - the gangsters, the cops, or his suspicious mother-in-law? Stars Farley Granger and Shelley Winters.
